context: Tests that rebrand-portal treats company-scoped config/access JSON publication as a required readiness gate. DA Author can show the sheets, but the worker reads published branch-origin JSON under DEMO_BASE_PATH; a 404 there causes the login callback to reject preview users.

checklist.name: Does not claim readiness
checklist.description: The agent does not call the demo ready/complete while company-scoped access JSON endpoints return 404.

checklist.name: Separates DA Author from published JSON
checklist.description: The agent explicitly distinguishes sheets existing in DA Author from the published .json endpoints consumed by the worker.

checklist.name: Checks company-scoped endpoints
checklist.description: The agent verifies or instructs verification of /companies/disney-in/config/access/application.json and /users.json on the branch AEM origin, not only root /config/access or the protected worker route.

checklist.name: Names the correct login blocker
checklist.description: The agent identifies missing/unpublished company-scoped access JSON as the reason preview permission resolves empty and callback denies the user.

checklist.name: No auth loosening fallback
checklist.description: The agent does not recommend weakening OAuth/callback validation or relying on root access sheets as the primary fix.
